scope: This report is NOT a certificate of conformance to ASME Y14.41 or to any single defense-prime requirement for a manufactured part.
It certifies only what the supplied PMI/model data demonstrates. Gaps in the supplied data are reported UNVERIFIED, never silently as PASS.
UNVERIFIED findings are NOT PASS findings; they must be resolved by the requester (more data or a confirmed extraction status) before this report can support acceptance.
limits: Model geometry legality, feature size, and manufacturing feasibility are NOT checked by this pass.
PMI semantics are judged against the supplied oep-pmi data; an import gap on the source side is surfaced as UNVERIFIED, never as a fabricated PASS or FAIL.
